payload.message:
Run the free models monitor:

python3 -m free_models_monitor.monitor --format json --scan-dir <PATH_TO_AGENT_CONFIGS>

If the exit code is 2 (change detected):
1. Send the full report to the user on their notification channel.
2. If a model was removed and a fallback was suggested, follow SKILL.md to apply the switch with free_models_monitor.switch, then restart the gateway if your harness needs it.

If the exit code is 0, send a one-line summary.
If the exit code is 1, report the error.

Rules:
- No markdown
- No emojis
- Reply with only the final text
- End with NO_REPLY
